title: ChemiCraft
description: ChemiCraft is s Chemistry mod that adds multiple chemicals and minerals for you mess around with!
body:
ChemiCraft adds a bunch of chemicals and minerals for you to mess around with. ChemiCraft also adds the Chemical Table, The Grinder and a Centerfuge! The Minerals can range from very radiocative enriched uranium to salt that you put on food!                                        
                                                                                                           
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Planned Features:
- Configs
- Add building block materials like Aluminum, Steel, Rubber, etc.
- Add Compatibilty to tech mods like Mekanisim or Create.
- Chemical Reactions
